candidates.change_summary: Change the transfer condition from block.number % 15 == 0 to block.number % 15 != 0.
Remove the block.timestamp > pastBlockTime requirement so any subsequent call in the same block can succeed.
Delete the require(msg.value == 10 ether) statement, allowing any msg.value to trigger the logic.
Delete the pastBlockTime = block.timestamp update, so the timestamp guard never advances.
Delete the ether transfer inside the if block, so the balance is never sent to the caller.
